scope: bounded same-date Heston development pilot within training period; no neural training or new data collection
research_question: Do Greek-informed neural networks improve FTSE MIB pricing accuracy, stability and sensitivity consistency under illiquidity and sparse data?

split.rule: sort distinct strikes within each date/expiry; zero-based rank modulo 5 == 4 is development control, all others fit; both option sides stay together
split.small_terms: fewer than 5 strikes gives no controls; report explicitly
split.chronological_holdouts: original boundaries unchanged; no validation/test access

calibration.frequency: one independent fit per selected date
calibration.parameters: five Heston parameters jointly across eligible maturities
calibration.main_carry: same-date WRDS r and q, unchanged

optimizer.selection: lowest historical-fit objective among successful starts only

calibration.objective: (price - market mid) / max(halfspread, 1 index point) on fit rows only

forward_sensitivity.purpose: isolate input effect; reprice same fitted Heston parameters, no second calibration
forward_sensitivity.estimate_from: matched call/put FIT groups on same date/expiry only
forward_sensitivity.estimator: midpoint of strictly positive common forward interval from fit-pair bid/ask ranges
forward_sensitivity.missing_or_inconsistent: mark unavailable for that term; no fallback presented as own estimate; main result retains rows
forward_sensitivity.comparison: report WRDS versus alternative q only on identical control rows with available estimate
forward_sensitivity.interpretation: same-date conditional sensitivity; not independent forecasting or an optimized competing calibration

liquidity_reporting.spread: report spread continuously; no new wide-spread cutoff
liquidity_reporting.sparse_data: do not discard thin groups merely for poor errors

mc_alignment.status: final MC benchmark still requires explicit implementation and numerical validation; analytic results must not be called MC

neural_stage.shared_price_target: market mid for fair empirical comparison; explicitly correct conflicting chapter 5.2 text later
neural_stage.differential_consistency: price derivatives must be connected to price output; vendor Greeks require unit/price-basis check before training
